page_title: WOL 2-2 HOL | Wolfsburg v Holstein Kiel 24/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+2' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+1' This is a yellow card! Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' The attendance is 22103.
87' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Konstantinos Koulierakis will be replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
85' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Substitution. Tiago Tomas did his best and is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).

80' 2 - 2 Goal! A terrific long pass from Benedikt Pichler picks out an unmarked Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the right side of the goal. 2:2.
79' Substitution. Dominik Javorcek will be replaced by John Tolkin (Holstein Kiel).
79' Marcel Rapp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) replacing Andu Yobel Kelati.
79' That's the end of the game for Phil Harres, who is replaced by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel).
77' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for an infringement.
75' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will take the corner.

74' What a save from Timon Weiner! Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

73' Great ball in from Andreas Skov Olsen. Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
71' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
71' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Mattias Svanberg is replaced by Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg).

70' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Magnus Knudsen comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 16:4. 3:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
64' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared away by the defence.
63' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
63' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Holstein Kiel.
60' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) will miss the next game.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch for Shuto Machino.
58' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
58' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
57' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
55' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
53' 2 - 1 Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 2:1.
53' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner.

52' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Timon Weiner anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. It will be a corner kick for Wolfsburg.

50' 1 - 1 Goal! Jonas Wind displays great vision and sends a pass to Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:1.

49' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
48' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is replaced by Patrick Wimmer.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a switch. Andreas Skov Olsen is coming on in place of Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Sven Jablonski starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
43' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
41' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.

39' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
38' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
36' The resulting corner from Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) is cleared.
35' Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Holstein Kiel earn a corner.
33' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
32' The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
31' Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Holstein Kiel was in an offside position.
28' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) brings an opponent down and Sven Jablonski interrupts the game.

26' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) wins the aerial duel to reach the cross from Kilian Fischer, but the ball slips off his head and flies well wide of the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
25' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
25' Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Wolfsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by David Zec (Holstein Kiel) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
20' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Good clearance! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities. Ball possession – 71:29.
15' PENALTY APPEAL after Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

13' 0 - 1 Goal! Dominik Javorcek launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of David Zec (Holstein Kiel), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the top left corner. It's 0:1.
13' Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) will deliver the corner kick.
11' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
9' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
7' A pass from Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by Timon Weiner and the move breaks down.
6' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
6' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) steps up to send the ball in.
3' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Holstein Kiel will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will referee today's match.
